message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 in Europeans**

| Population | Minor allele (T) frequency |
|------------|-----------------------------|
| Non‑Finnish European (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.08** (MAF = 0.079) |
| Finnish (gnomAD v2.1.1) | ≈ 0.07 |

*Interpretation:*  
In most European cohorts the T allele (which defines the APOE ε2 haplotype) occurs in roughly 7–8 % of chromosomes. The complementary C allele is therefore the major allele (~92 %).  

These figures come from the gnomAD database (v2.1.1), which aggregates exome and genome sequencing data from >60 000 individuals of diverse ancestries. The European subset contains >12 000 samples, providing robust estimates for common variants such as rs7412.
